title: Sonu @ Subhash Kumar v. State of U.P.

content.caseIdentity: Sonu @ Subhash Kumar v. State of U.P., (2021) 18 SCC 517
content.holding: Reiterated that consensual sexual intercourse between two adults during an ongoing courtship cannot be treated as rape or criminal deceit simply because the marriage could not materialize due to family opposition.
